source.title: Family Farm Adventure - Gameplay Walkthrough part 1 - Tutorial (iOS,Android)

core_loop: Seen: Read and advance NPC dialogue that sets the restoration goal.
Seen: Follow tutorial highlights by tapping blue speech-bubble markers on NPCs or objects.
Seen: Open and confirm a "Land Clearing" action to work on blocked island terrain.
Inferred: Interact with farm production objects, including an Eggs prompt with a speed-up option.
Inferred: Use visible currencies/resources to continue clearing, restoring, and building on the farm.
Inferred: Complete objective/book prompts to advance the Flower Festival story and unlock more farm content.
controls: Seen: Tap the dialogue box or orange down-chevron to advance story text.
Seen: Tap highlighted blue speech-bubble markers to interact with NPCs or tutorial targets.
Seen: Tap the orange "Land Clearing" action button in the modal.
Seen: Tap the highlighted speed-up or collection control to get Eggs instantly, per the tutorial text; the exact target and cost are unclear.
Seen: No drag, swipe, or hold affordance is visible in the sampled frames.
progression: Seen: The story premise is Felicia returning home for the Flower Festival, while Grandma explains the Flower Farm is damaged after an earthquake.
Seen: The sampled tutorial introduces dialogue, highlighted NPC/object interaction, land clearing, and an Eggs speed-up interaction.
Seen: UI exposes a top-center progress bar, top-right resource counters, a bottom-left book/objective icon, and a bottom-right crate icon.
Seen: Visible farm elements include sunflowers, farm buildings or stalls, docks, blocked or ruined terrain, and an Eggs production prompt.
Inferred: Expansion axes are land clearing, building restoration or construction, flower/crop production, animal or egg production, and story/festival progress.
Inferred: Currencies/resources are earned or spent during these actions, but their names, costs, and rates are not visible.
spec.session_feel: Seen: The sampled tutorial uses bright isometric island art, character portraits, dimmed spotlight prompts, modal popups, and bottom dialogue, creating a guided cozy farm-restoration feel. Inferred: Pacing is casual and tap-driven with short objective chunks; animation/juice appears moderate but stills cannot show motion; session length is likely measured in short tutorial/objective segments, but exact session length is not knowable from these frames.
confidence_notes: All claims in the other arrays are marked Seen or Inferred.
The frame sample cannot tell real-time versus turn-based timing, exact production timers, cooldowns, action durations, or whether most actions complete instantly.
